    What famous people died in 2026?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Several notable figures died in early 2026, including actress Catherine O'Hara (Jan 30), actor James Van Der Beek (Feb 11), Oscar-winning actor Robert Duvall (Feb 15), Grey's Anatomy star Eric Dane (Feb 19), and designer Valentino Garavani (Jan 19). Other prominent deaths include Grateful Dead member Bob Weir (Jan 10) and drummer Sly Dunbar (Jan 26). 
    Key 2026 Deaths (as of March 2026): 
    • Catherine O'Hara (Jan 30): Comedy legend known for Schitt's Creek and Home Alone.
    • James Van Der Beek (Feb 11): Dawson's Creek actor, died of colorectal cancer.
    • Robert Duvall (Feb 15): The Godfather and Tender Mercies actor.
    • Eric Dane (Feb 19): Grey's Anatomy and Euphoria actor.
    • Valentino Garavani (Jan 19): Italian fashion icon.
    • Bob Weir (Jan 10): Founding member of the Grateful Dead.
    • Sly Dunbar (Jan 26): Famed reggae drummer of Sly and Robbie.
    • Phil Campbell (March 13): Former Motörhead guitarist. 
    Other notable deaths include hockey hall of famer Glenn Hall (Jan 7) and CIA officer-turned-spy Aldrich Ames (Jan 5).
